title: What my CoSchedule spec forgot: 27/27 checks passed, 8 gaps found #shorts
description:
Claude built a CoSchedule alternative, a content calendar where nothing is scheduled without an editor's approval, from one written spec. All 27 acceptance checks passed, and the build exposed 8 gaps in the spec. The surprise: nothing stopped an edit after a piece was in review or scheduled, and the test build allowed it. The spec now refuses those edits.

Full build test (2:42): https://youtu.be/KpdbUvlQ_s4
The free spec: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/blueprints/content-calendar
CoSchedule pricing and alternatives: https://personalsoftwarefactory.com/alternatives/coschedule

Made with AI: Sam's on-camera hook and outro are an AI avatar of him, and the narration is his AI voice clone (HeyGen). The product footage is from the real test build.
